skill.name: doc-coauthoring
skill.description: Guide users through a structured workflow for drafting documentation, proposals, technical specs, decision docs, and similar structured content.
skill.summary: Co-author documentation through context gathering, section drafting, iterative refinement, and reader testing.
skill.author: davila7

content.value_statement: Important documents often fail because context stays in the author's head. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through a structured co-authoring workflow.
actual_capabilities: Guides initial context gathering with audience, impact, template, and constraint questions.
Helps create document structures with section headers and placeholder text.
Supports section drafting through clarifying questions, brainstorming, curation, and targeted edits.
Recommends Reader Claude testing to find ambiguity, missing context, and incorrect interpretations.
Adapts between artifact workflows and markdown file workflows when file access is available.
limitations: Requires user-provided context or approved integrations to understand private project details.
Does not independently verify facts, links, or technical claims.
Reader testing is manual when sub-agents or fresh conversations are unavailable.
File creation and artifact updates depend on the host tool environment.

use_cases.title: Draft Technical Specs
use_cases.description: Turn architecture context, constraints, and trade-offs into a structured technical specification.

use_cases.title: Prepare Decision Documents
use_cases.description: Shape a decision, proposal, or RFC so stakeholders can understand the reasoning and impact.

use_cases.title: Improve Internal Documentation
use_cases.description: Refine existing documentation through section edits, consistency checks, and reader-focused testing.

prompt_templates.title: Start A Documentation Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the doc co-authoring workflow to help me draft a technical spec. Ask me the initial context questions first.

prompt_templates.title: Build A Document Structure
prompt_templates.prompt: I have context for a decision doc. Help me choose sections, create placeholders, and decide which section to draft first.

prompt_templates.title: Refine One Section
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the doc co-authoring workflow to improve the proposal section below. Ask clarifying questions, brainstorm options, then apply targeted edits.

prompt_templates.title: Run Reader Testing
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the completed RFC below to generate reader questions, prepare Reader Claude testing, and list gaps to fix.

output_examples.input: A user asks for help writing a technical spec from rough project notes.
output_examples.output: The assistant asks about document type, audience, desired impact, template, constraints, and missing context before proposing sections.

output_examples.input: A user has a draft decision document but is unsure whether readers will understand it.
output_examples.output: The assistant generates reader questions, checks likely ambiguities, and identifies sections that need clearer context or stronger evidence.

output_examples.input: A user wants to improve one proposal section without rewriting the whole document.
output_examples.output: The assistant asks targeted questions, brainstorms options, applies focused edits, and asks for feedback before moving on.

best_practices: Share audience, desired impact, constraints, and templates before drafting begins.
Give numbered feedback so the workflow can learn what to keep, remove, or combine.
Run reader testing before sharing the document with stakeholders.
anti_patterns: Starting with final prose before enough context has been gathered.
Requesting full-document rewrites when a targeted section edit is enough.
Skipping final fact checks for links, names, dates, and technical details.

faq.question: What types of documents does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports documentation, proposals, technical specs, decision docs, RFCs, and similar structured documents.

faq.question: Does it write the whole document at once?
faq.answer: No. It works section by section so context, structure, and edits stay manageable.

faq.question: Can it use existing templates?
faq.answer: Yes. Share the template or describe the required format before the structure is created.

faq.question: What is Reader Claude testing?
faq.answer: It tests whether a fresh Claude conversation can answer reader questions using only the document.

faq.question: Does it need integrations?
faq.answer: No. Integrations can help gather context, but users can also paste notes, links, or document text.

faq.question: Who is responsible for final accuracy?
faq.answer: The user remains responsible for checking facts, links, technical details, and stakeholder expectations.
